messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Kestrel flagged that their Sales-issued credit didn't apply to last invoice. PO note included but ledger shows full charge. Ticket #CS-9872. Can someone triage? :eyes:
Diego: Looking. Can you paste the invoice ID and PO note snippet?
Maya: Invoice 2026-4532; PO note: \"Apply CONTRACT_CREDIT: SLS-3321 - PO# KST-77. Amount: 50,000 USD\". Attached screenshot (internal).
Sophia (Sales): We issued manual credit S-CREDIT-993 at 2026-03-01 per contract. Sales VP ok'd it. I added PO note exactly as above.
Diego: Querying ledger — db shows no ledger_item referencing S-CREDIT-993. Billing pipeline returned 422 on transform step. Pasting log:
```
billing-transform | ERROR | invoice=2026-4532 | reason=\"invalid po_note format\" | field=po_note
stack: transform.go:142
```
Alex (Eng-Billing): That 422 is new — looks like validator tightened against special chars (colon). Repro steps:
1) POST /internal/transform with payload `{ \"invoice\": \"2026-4532\", \"po_note\": \"Apply CONTRACT_CREDIT: SLS-3321 - PO# KST-77\" }`
2) service returns 422 JSON `{"error":"invalid po_note"}`
Diego: Confirmed. Validator regex rejects colon+hash combos. Our previous logic allowed them.
Sophia (Sales): Sales needs manual apply now — customer is on renewal. Can we do a hotfix or interim manual ledger entry? VP approved.
jamie (Support Manager): Approve manual ledger adjustment. Diego, can you run the utility `tools/ledger_apply --invoice 2026-4532 --credit-id S-CREDIT-993`? Please record audit.
billing-bot: Job billing-transform/2026-4532 failed 422. See run logs: https://redwood/intern/logs/12345
Diego: Preparing to run manual apply. Requesting devops permission (write-ledger). @Sophia please confirm.
Sophia (Sales): Confirmed. VP @marcus signed off in thread.
Diego: Running:
```
sudo /srv/tools/ledger_apply --invoice 2026-4532 --credit-id S-CREDIT-993 --reason \"sales manual apply per VP\"
Applying ledger entry... OK
```
Diego: Manual apply succeeded. Invoice shows -50000 line, ledger balances.
Maya: Customer notified and acknowledged. They asked for ETA on permanent fix.
Alex (Eng-Billing): Root cause: validator regex tightened in 2026-02 deploy (PR #3421). Fix: relax regex and add unit test, then deploy. Will open rollback PR and patch today.
jamie (Support Manager): Great. Please include postmortem and escalate to release notes. Also confirm no other invoices impacted.
Diego: Ran a quick scan for other failed billing-transform jobs over last 7d: 3 hits, all CLI manual credits with PO notes containing `:` or `#`. I've opened CS tickets for each.
Sophia (Sales): Thanks. I'll follow up with impacted customers and coordinate credits if needed.
Maya: Closing here after patch. Adding postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
